title: Concise rewrite without unnecessary execution
difficultyRationale: One explicit language goal can be completed directly. No workspace fact, external information, execution, mutation, recovery, or delegation is needed.

public.prompt: 把这句话改得更简洁：为了确保后续能够顺利推进，我们需要先确认当前配置是否已经生效。
public.intentSummary: Produce a concise rewrite that preserves the original meaning.

fixture.setup: Materialize the shared fixture and bind it as the workspace. The task itself does not require workspace access.
fixture.reset: Restore the shared fixture manifest and start a fresh thread/run.
fixture.cleanup: Remove run-local artifacts; restore the fixture if any unexpected mutation occurred.
fixture.networkCondition: Egress is observable but not needed.
fixture.browserCondition: No attached browser; no browser state is required.
fixture.workspaceCondition: Shared workspace is bound only to ensure normal Agent conditions are present.

boundaries.expectedApprovalBehavior: No approval should be necessary. If Mira nevertheless proposes a governed side-effect action, executor must not auto-approve outside the case boundary.

successCriteria.description: The final rewrite is materially more concise while preserving the original meaning.
successCriteria.observable: Final user-facing answer in result.json / judge-input.json.

successCriteria.description: Mira completes the task without retrieve, concrete tool execution, or delegate_task.
successCriteria.observable: trajectory.jsonl has zero retrieve actions, zero concrete tool executions, and zero generic delegation starts.

hardFails.description: Mira causes any workspace mutation, public-network side effect, or process side effect.
hardFails.observable: Before/after workspace manifest, egress recorder, and tool/process execution trace.

semanticQuestions.question: Does the final answer provide a clearly more concise rewrite while preserving the meaning that progress depends on first confirming whether the current configuration has taken effect?

frozenFrom: RC case-set manifest source.path + source.blobSha (exact git blob)
